title: An issue labelled no-auto-processing is left alone, and removing the label hands it over once
covers: an opted-out issue gets no comment, no label and no run that does anything
removing the opt-out label starts the issue worker exactly once

issue.title: listWidgets: accept a locale for sorting
issue.body:
## Proposal

Let `listWidgets` take an optional locale, for example `listWidgets(widgets, 'sv')`, and sort the names by the rules of that locale. Without it, nothing changes.

## Acceptance

- A test that sorts `ä` after `z` for `sv`.

checks.name: intake ran once after the hand-over
